best_idea: Hold capacity for an incoming item when the walk starts, commit it on arrival after a re-check, and give the hold back on cancel, so two actors cannot both book the last of a limited container.
decision_why: Take the reserve-at-engage, re-check-and-commit and release-on-cancel budget; fix the donor's weight-sum lock test (zero-weight holds) and its unchecked commit (scripted loads can overfill) in the sketch; reject the aircraft landing and takeoff and the cell search.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a second hero engaging a chest whose pack room is held by a first hero's engage is refused; cancelling the first hero's walk returns the room; a scripted grant that would exceed the pack cap is refused by the ledger; and a zero-weight hold still holds the pack lock until it is committed or cancelled.
